trust_decision.summary: The fix places trust in output encoding rather than input filtering: the group name/title is stored after only HTMLPurifier sanitising (which still permits a/img/span and data: URIs) and is then concatenated raw into the group-edit HTML and into select2 JSON, so whoever can create or rename a group can inject markup that other users' pages render.

landing_point.why: The summary names only modules/utenti/edit.php; reading the template top-down the first raw echo is the group title inside the 'Utenti del gruppo' card head, and the same construction repeats at line 252 for the permissions card, so an engineer fixes those two echoes first.

fix_sites.entry_point: GET ajax_select.php (every resource funnelled through AJAX::select / AJAX::selectResults)
Modules::link() public helper, e.g. called from modules/utenti/edit.php:124
every filter()/post()/get() call, i.e. all POST and GET input

O3_reason_to_dismiss: Modules::link and AJAX::selectResults are core helpers in src/ that every module uses; an engineer reading an advisory titled 'HTML Injection in modules/utenti/edit.php' can reasonably claim they are generic library code outside the reported page, and likewise that other modules' select2 sources were never part of the report.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Modules::link callers intentionally pass icon markup as the text (e.g. ' ...'), which link() detects and re-emits as a separate icon; the published fix escapes $testo before the ' tags because the new global default drops them.

O6_input_shapes: plain DB column echoed directly ($record['nome'] from zz_groups)
translated field read through getTranslation() from zz_groups_lang.title
value inside an HTML attribute used as a dialog message (data-msg / data-title) and inside JS strings
select2 JSON with two structures: flat rows remapped through a $custom map (AJAX::selectResults) and nested optgroup/children arrays built inside the resource file
absent column key, which the fix guards with ?? ''
rich HTML that must stay working: email body with <a> links (setAllowedTags + forceParse)
text that deliberately contains markup, i.e. the icon branch of Modules::link

O7_producer.where: src/Traits/RecordTrait.php:100-125 (save() copies nome into zz_groups_lang.title for every locale)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Group name re-echoed raw inside the data-msg HTML attribute of the 'Reimposta permessi' button (concatenated into the tr() source string)
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: The fix escaped the visible card title three lines above; this is a confirmation message, not the reported heading.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same file, 3 lines below the patched echo

O8_uncovered_routes.route: User rows on the same group page echo username, email, tipo-anagrafica GROUP_CONCAT and sede names without escaping
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: The advisory names the group title only; usernames and anagrafica data are a different data source on the same page.

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Second implementation of the module-link builder: ButtonManager::link() writes a template/print/email/SMS title into the <a> text and into data-title with no escaping
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: It is the HTMLBuilder button pipeline for print/email/SMS templates, a different class and package from the Modules::link helper the fix touched.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: src/HTMLBuilder/Manager/ vs src/Modules.php; separate code doing the same job

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Another module's select2 resource returns anagrafica ragione_sociale and tipo-anagrafica titles as raw 'text' in the same optgroup/children shape the fix escaped in utenti
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Different module and feature from the reported group page; the report never mentions AJAX select sources.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: the same group name placed in an attribute/dialog context next to the escaped one
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: the maintainer already wrote exactly this three lines below the title they fixed, using the same $record['nome'] variable

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a 'gruppi' select2 resource that returns the group title as 'text'
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: the same file already has four resources; two got in-file escaping in the fix and two rely on the shared mapper, so a maintainer adding a fifth would copy either shape

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a new link kind in transformElementLink that wraps element text in <a>/<i> markup
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: the function already builds intentional markup for stampa, allegato, module: and plugin:, each time concatenating the unescaped element text

O9_family: HTML injection / stored XSS (CWE-79) caused by missing output encoding of stored, admin-editable text

O10_build.toolchain: composer install; yarn/npm run build-OSM for assets; php artisan (Laravel 12 skeleton)
services: Apache or the PHP built-in server
